subject.title: Track Usage & Spend production hardening and sharing follow-ups

question: Should the repository sponsor the proposed sequence of correctness fixes first, followed by a separately approved dashboard/share contract for the remaining design work?
rationale: The open work includes new sharing and information-architecture scope whose accepted product boundary cannot be inferred from the existing tracker or implementation PRs alone.

options.title: Adopt the staged sequence
options.body: Review the focused correctness PRs independently, then require an approved dashboard/share contract before accepting redesign or native-sharing work.

options.title: Pause the broader product work
options.body: Keep correctness fixes moving but defer dashboard redesign and native sharing until the repository has a clearer Usage & Spend roadmap.

recommendation.title: Adopt the staged sequence
recommendation.body: Review the focused correctness PRs independently, then require an approved dashboard/share contract before accepting redesign or native-sharing work.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner, they are the best available decision point for whether these new product surfaces should be sponsored and in what order.
